text: D5b reading conventions, adopted while reading pages 1 to 5 and applied to all: a celebration posted after the close (hour 73 or later) counts as stood; an edit posted after the close is read by its content; hour 72 is applied strictly (popheads h70.09, python h71.59 and the like are 'during'); a final canvas or final image posted without naming the room's work is 'unclear'; a line about a flair, a replacement canvas or a remark is 'other'. Three corrections applied as overrides in out/_analysis/d5b_survival.py, the reading files unchanged: detroitlions other to unclear (mixed: the face said not to survive, the field says kept); placetardis other to unclear (a member's hour, as edboxes and seahawks); liverpoolfc stood to unclear (a post that place ended, as malaysia). Readings are independent of the field; agreement is computed afterwards.

D5b survival figures (out/_analysis/d5b_survival.py, output d5b_survival.json; read before this line): 476 rooms in a branch, all re-read, none missing. Median organizing end 72.20 (population 72.02); 53 ended before hour 64, 303 between 64 and 73, 120 at 73 or later; 117 coordinated in the aftermath; aftermath share mean 0.0213 (population 0.0200), the convention branches-D5.jsonl uses. The field as the ledger gives it: kept 253, lost 161, silent 62. The re-reading: stood 149, gone 43, during 115, other 63, unclear 44, silent 62. Of the 253 'kept': stood 146, during 61, unclear 23, other 20, gone 3. Of the 161 'lost': gone 40, during 54, other 43, unclear 21, stood 3. The field agrees with the re-reading in 248 of 476. Per branch, the branches-D5 survival lines match the recomputation (median end, mean aftermath share, kept/lost/silent) in all 35. Branches ending latest: F12 (80.76; 14 of 22 after 73) and F23 (80.66; 24 of 30); F11 73.48 (23 of 43). Earliest: F14 and F33 (70.59). F18: no member coordinated after the close (0 of 15).

D5b timing rule, written before computing (stage D5 section 4): a dated change is a sentence in a branch narrative (section 1, extracted by out/_analysis/d5b_dated.py) that dates an act on the canvas by a named room's members: placing, building, fixing, changing the design, moving the work, or a marking followed by keeping; remarks, requests, invitations and acts at or after hour 73 are not; an act after hour 72 is not checkable (the series ends at 72). For each, the room's px_by_window_members in the four hourly bins before the dated hour's bin against the four bins from it (fewer at the series' ends), with px_in_region_any beside it. The placements move if after/before is 1.5 or more, or 0.67 or less, and the larger side has 10 placements or more. Each act's implied direction is set before computing: building, fixing or a design change implies a rise; moving the work away or ceasing to defend implies a fall; a marking followed by keeping implies no fall. Corroborated: the series moves the implied way, or, for no fall, does not fall. Contradicted: it moves the other way, or falls where no fall was implied; a contradicted timing is named as a question for the account. Not shown: no move where a rise or fall was implied. A timing is corroborated, never a mechanism. 25 acts listed in out/_analysis/d5b_timing.py.

D5b timing check (out/_analysis/d5b_timing.py, output d5b_timing.json; read before this line): 25 dated acts; 2 not checkable (chibears h72.99, cowchop h73.11: after the series ends); of 23 checked, corroborated 16, contradicted 4, not shown 3. Amendment, made after seeing the output and applying to it only: a window with no member placement on either side is 'empty' and corroborates nothing; it moves ockytop (h35.56) from corroborated to empty, so corroborated 15, empty 1 (clubpenguin's window is also empty and was already 'not shown'). Contradicted, each a question for its account: thebluecorner h39 (F23, F25; members' placements fall from about 600 to about 260 an hour after the call to a copy of the canvas, which the narrative read as something to do beside it); hawks h61.14 (F27; the colour detail announced, placements fall); faeria h29.15 (F31; pasture secured, placements fall, on 11 against 4); httyd h52.45 (F32; marked, then placements fall, 183 against 118). Not shown: clubpenguin, tagpro, paragon. A timing only; no mechanism.

D5b waterfall rule, stated before the walk: the branch is the parent with subforms (F01, F11, F17) whose subforms cover the largest share of its members (F11: 38 of 43; F17 29 of 36; F01 68 of 103), so the walk passes through a subform that represents its parent; the subform is that parent's largest (F12, 22, the spine restarted on another canvas); the room is the subform's member at the lower median of coded concepts (statistics.median_low over the 22; the sorted list was printed before the even-count convention was fixed, and the upper median would be greyblob, 115): forsen, 114 coded concepts, against the population median of 101. Chosen neither by fit nor by size. The walk: account.md, F11's account, F12's account, rooms/forsen/model-D.md, its adaptation lines, its quotes through cite.py; then back up, saying at each step what was added and whether it contradicts the level above; read against prior.md section 2 (the operator's expectation that the lower levels describe decline and continuity).

waterfall-D5.md written (3,356 words with the held proposals appended in full from tree-D4.md by out/_analysis/d5b_held.py; quotes 13 verbatim, rooms analysed, prose 0 dashes, 0 contractions). The walk's steps: (1) account.md: carrying on after the record in 113 of 145 rooms [A09, P13], an order across rooms; (2) F11 (43): carrying on is new work; A09 restricted in 15 members; 11 of 43 begin before the close; (3) F12 (22): the spine again on another canvas, key at T3-054, whose gloss also holds turning a later canvas down; (4) r/forsen's re-check model: continuation proposed through another site and a queued song, A09 absent, building on the site unresolved; verdicts composes with residue then composes, grade composes-with-residue, local status unresolved; (5) lines: R-forsen-d98406bef832-062 (add-step P13, the song) alone puts the room into F11 and F12; (6) quotes c0097, c0098, c0102, c0103, c0095, c0083, c0084, c0104, c0106. Back up: holds to the room model; contradicts F12's name (membership on a song, no building on the other canvas); contradicts the second half of F11's name (after the close); shows A09's order (loss announced 73.20 before the song 73.48) and no cause, which is all the account's count claims. Against prior.md: a model all the way down held; continuity at the top; the subform's condition drops at the room; decline and continuity both; credit, blame, mourning and a call to a successor canvas all present. Canvas, afterwards: the atlas links a monkaS figure that the record calls gone; a question for the room's account. What the members showed that the room notes did not predict: the organizing end is the song proposal itself (73.48).

D5b canvas projected onto the re-reading, afterwards (out/_analysis/d5b_canvas_by_reading.py, output d5b_canvas_by_reading.json; read before this line): of the 476 rooms in a branch, 475 have an artwork; by re-reading, median area stood 770 (149 rooms), gone 758 (43), during 572 (115), other 1,237.5 (63), unclear 668 (44), silent 309 (62, 61 with artwork); members' share of their placements in hours 64 to 73: stood 0.165, gone 0.201. By the field: kept 764.5, lost 679.5. The canvas does not separate stood from gone at this grain; the frame is built from artworks that survived, so it cannot show a room that kept nothing.
